rows.label: PPP conversion factor (2017 international $ per US $)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: PPP conversion factor, private consumption (PA.NUS.PRVT.PP), 2017
source.note: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/PSE/indicator/PA.NUS.PRVT.PP?format=json&date=2017. The World Bank keeps Palestine's national accounts in US dollars (no PA.NUS.FCRF), so the factor is US$ per international $ and the conversion is its inverse: 1 / 0.595765 = 1.6785.

rows.explainer: How much more a US dollar buys in Palestine than in the US, at 2017 private-consumption prices. Converts goods delivered into the same purchasing power as consumption surveys.

rows.label: Crude death rate, Palestine, 2022, before the war (deaths per person-year)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: death rate, crude (per 1,000 people) (SP.DYN.CDRT.IN), 2022
source.note: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/PSE/indicator/SP.DYN.CDRT.IN?format=json&date=2019:2024 (2019 3.134, 2020 3.391, 2021 3.768, 2022 2.992, then 7.198 in 2023 with the war); 2.992 / 1000. The last year before the war; Gaza's population is younger than the West Bank's, so its own rate was if anything lower.

rows.explainer: Palestine's normal death rate before the war, the base above which the war's excess deaths from hunger and disease are counted.
